falas.texto: São Paulo produces a great deal of organic waste, on farms and in cities — yet only a small share becomes energy.
To change that, CP2B was born: the São Paulo Center for Biogas and Bioproducts Studies!
falas.fala: To change that, C-P-two-B was born: the São Paulo Center for Biogas and Bioproducts Studies!

falas.texto: Based at NIPE, at Unicamp, and supported by FAPESP.
Our mission: turning waste into biogas, biomethane and bioproducts — through science, technology and social impact.
We work as a living lab, testing solutions in the field — from waste inventories to public policy.
We are a network of researchers, universities and companies, in Brazil and abroad.
Driven by excellence, ethics, diversity and a commitment to society.
We want São Paulo to become a showcase for biogas solutions — and a benchmark across Latin America!
CP2B: living energy, science that transforms!
falas.fala: C-P-two-B: living energy, science that transforms!
